```{r, message = FALSE}
library(Seurat)
#library(escape)
library(msigdbr)

library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(gridExtra)

library(Nebulosa)

data_storage_folder = file.path("../../../../Data/ExtData/Zhang_scRNA/PySCENIC_with_GCA_downsampled")

result_folder = "../../../../Results/Zhang_scRNA/PySCENIC_with_intestine_downsampled/"
if (!file.exists(result_folder)) dir.create(result_folder, recursive=T)
```
# Overview

This analysis is based on a PySCENIC analysis of the full data set of Zhang et al gastric samples

```{r}
scData <- readRDS(file.path("../../../../Data/ExtData/Zhang_scRNA", "ZhangIM_and_GutCellAtlas_HealthyAdult_Epi_BBKNN_CC_adjusted.RData"))
meta <- readRDS("../../../../Data/ExtData/Zhang_scRNA/Zhang_IM_and_intestine_Epi_only_BBKNN_CC_adj_cluster_Metadata.RData")
scData@meta.data <- meta[Cells(scData),]

scData$cluster_label <- factor(scData$cluster_label, levels=c("Sto gland base","Pit cells 1","Pit cells 2","Pit cells 3","Intestinal stem cell","Enterocyte DD","Enterocyte proximal","TA/Colonocyte","BEST4+ epithelial","Colonocyte AQP8","Colonocyte FABP1","Colonocyte MUC5B","Goblet cell","Paneth","Enteroendocrine","Tuft"))
```


```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=8}
scData <- SetIdent(scData, value="cluster_label")
DimPlot(scData, label=T) + NoLegend()
```


```{r}
n="Zhang_IM_intestine"
pyscenic_res = read.table(file.path("../../../../Data/ExtData/Zhang_scRNA/PySCENIC_with_GCA_downsampled/",paste0(n,"/auc_mtx.csv")), sep=",", header=T)
colnames(pyscenic_res) = gsub("\\.\\.\\.", "", colnames(pyscenic_res))
```

# Score distribution overview

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
all_tf_names = colnames(pyscenic_res)[2:ncol(pyscenic_res)]
par(mfrow=c(4,4))
tmp = mapply(function(x,n) hist(x, breaks=100, main=n, xlab="Score", xlim=c(0,1)), pyscenic_res[, all_tf_names], all_tf_names)
```

```{r}
tmp = pyscenic_res[, 2:ncol(pyscenic_res)]
rownames(tmp) = pyscenic_res$Cell
scores_ordered <- tmp[rownames(tmp) %in% Cells(scData), ]
scores_ordered = tmp[Cells(scData)[Cells(scData) %in% rownames(scores_ordered)],]
```


# Overview of TF activity in across clusters

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=5, warning=FALSE}

scData <- SetIdent(scData, value="cluster_label")

all_new_cols = c()
for (n in all_tf_names) {
  nc = paste0(n,"_score")
  scData <- AddMetaData(scData, scores_ordered[Cells(scData), n], col.name = nc)
  all_new_cols = append(all_new_cols, nc)
  
  p1 = FeaturePlot(scData, features = nc, order=T, raster = T)
  p2 = VlnPlot(scData, features=nc, pt.size = 0) + NoLegend()
  #p3 = plot_density(scData, nc, slot = "data", method = "wkde")
  #layout_matrix = matrix(c(1,2,1,3),2,2)
  #grid.arrange(grobs = list(p2,p1,p3),ncol=2,nrow=2, layout_matrix = layout_matrix)
  print(plot_grid(p1,p2,ncol=2))
}
```

## UMAP on all clusters including stromal cells

```{r}
umap_file = file.path(data_storage_folder, "UMAP_on_TF_complete_DS_IM_and_intestine_downsamples.rds")

if(F) {
  ab = Seurat::RunUMAP(as.matrix(scores_ordered))
  saveRDS(ab, file = umap_file, compress = T)
} else {
  ab = readRDS(file = umap_file)
}

scData_orig <- scData
scData <- subset(scData, cells = rownames(scores_ordered))
scData@reductions$pyscenic = ab
```

```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=8}
scData <- SetIdent(scData, value="cluster_label")
scData@meta.data$condition = factor(scData$condition, levels=c("Non-atrophic gastritis","Chronic atrophic gastritis", "Mild intestinal metaplasia","Severe intestinal metaplasia", "Gut") |> rev())
DimPlot(scData, reduction = "pyscenic", label=T) + NoLegend()
DimPlot(scData, reduction = "pyscenic", label=T, split.by = "condition", ncol = 2) + NoLegend()
```
